observations: Photo 0 shows a brown fabric 3 seater sofa with multiple large tears in the seat cushions exposing inner material.
The backrest and armrests appear intact with quilted diamond stitching on the side panels.
A gold cloth is draped over the top backrest in both photos.
Photo 1 shows a similar brown sofa from another angle with torn seat upholstery; a second sofa is partially visible on the right edge but is not fully shown.
No brand name or model number is visible on the item in either photo.
A power strip is visible on the floor in photo 0.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 clearly shows a 3 seater; photo 1 shows only a partial second sofa on the right edge, not enough to confirm a 2 seater.
Photo 0 and photo 1 show torn seat upholstery with exposed inner layers.

claims.claim: All d wood inside are still intact
claims.evidence: The internal wooden frame is not visible in either photo.

risks.risk: Internal wooden frame may be broken or damaged despite seller claim.
risks.proof: Photo of the underside and frame, or view through the tears showing the wood structure.
risks.if_unproven: as needing frame repair or replacement

risks.risk: Seat foam and padding may be degraded or missing beneath the tears.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each tear showing the condition of the padding underneath.
risks.if_unproven: as needing full reupholstery and padding replacement

risks.risk: The advertised 2 seater may not exist, may be in different condition, or may not match.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the complete 2 seater sofa.
risks.if_unproven: priced as 3 seater only with no value assigned to the second piece

risks.risk: Upholstery may have stains, odors, or pest damage not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: Detailed close-ups of all seating surfaces and arms, or in-person inspection.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring deep cleaning or fabric replacement

proof_requests: Clear photo of the complete 2 seater sofa if it is included in the sale.
Photos of the underside and frame of the 3 seater.
Close-up photos of all tears and exposed padding on the seat cushions.
response.reason: The visible item is clearly a used 3 seater sofa with torn upholstery and can be priced at its worst case as needing full reupholstery; the claimed 2 seater and intact wood frame are unverified but do not prevent a worst case price.
